summary: Diff adds Month/Year selector components and updates ReportsPage logic to support monthly and annual period selection, but the monthly end-date calculation appears incorrect and there’s no clear evidence that the Financial Summary header and Print action were updated to reflect the selected month/year.

missing_requirements.requirement: Changing Month/Year updates the computed startDate/endDate used for filtering revenue/expenses/COGS totals to the selected calendar month.
missing_requirements.reason: In the monthly branch, endDate is computed as `new Date(selectedYear, selectedMonth, 0, 23, 59, 59)` while startDate uses `selectedMonth - 1`. With `selectedMonth` stored as 1–12, `new Date(year, selectedMonth, 0)` yields the last day of the previous month, not the selected month, so the computed range does not match the selected calendar month.

missing_requirements.requirement: The page’s "Financial Summary - … to …" header reflects the selected month’s date range.
missing_requirements.reason: The provided diff excerpt and file summary do not show any changes to the header rendering or any explicit linkage of the header text to the selected month/year-derived startDate/endDate.

missing_requirements.requirement: The "Print Report" action prints the report for the currently selected month/year without requiring the user to manually pick a specific day.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff does not provide evidence that the Print action behavior was updated/verified to use the selected month/year range (only date range computation and selectors are shown; print handling is not visible in the truncated content).
